content: Vivaan Gupta called about his expired travel policy (TRV-001234) and asked if it could be reinstated or if a new quote could be provided. Agent Neha Kapoor verified the expiration, offered a new quote, collected his date of birth, updated the system, and indicated she will prepare the next steps.

action_items: Agent to generate and send a new travel policy quote to Vivaan
Update policy information with provided date of birth
